label: About
title: About Quiet Bypass Cover
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 78 recent saved-signal files and 71 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around sssluke (@sssluke1) on X and @schauermannx2: old piece of paper, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Quiet Bypass Cover: A bright minimal cover-field, poster crop seen as an overhead scan: full-bleed warm off-white matte surface, one compact black illegible glyph procession centered slightly low, with a right-hand slanted gesture. Preserve severe empty margins. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against large blank pale field, central black glyph cluster, and individual letter apertures and counters.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
